mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS session_id,s.song_id,s.score_version,s.bpm,s.bpm_unit,s.status,s.started_at,s.ended_at,s.recording_duration_ms, s.start_note_idx,s.end_note_idx,e.id AS evaluation_id,e.total_score,e.pitch_score,e.timing_score,e.duration_score,e.evaluated_at, e.tuning_offset_cent,e.tuning_out_of_range,s.parent_session_id,e.model_version FROM practice_sessions s LEFT JOIN evaluations e ON e.session_id=s.id WHERE s.id=#{sessionId} AND s.user_id=#{userId} AND s.record_deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT s.id FROM practice_sessions s WHERE s.user_id=#{userId} AND s.song_id=#{songId} AND s.status='DONE' AND s.record_deleted_at IS NULL AND (s.started_at < #{startedAt} OR (s.started_at=#{startedAt} AND s.id < #{sessionId})) AND (s.score_version <> #{scoreVersion} OR (s.start_note_idx <= #{startNoteIdx} AND s.end_note_idx >= #{endNoteIdx})) ORDER BY s.started_at DESC,s.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id,evaluation_id,note_idx,expected_pitch_id,detected_pitch_id,pitch_error_cent,onset_error_ms,duration_error_ms,verdict,recording_offset_ms FROM note_results WHERE evaluation_id=#{evaluationId} ORDER BY note_idx
SELECT score_json,score_version FROM songs WHERE id=#{songId}
